partial.title: {{action}}: only part of the selection
partial.text: {{action}} applies to {{part}} of the {{total}} selected objects. These are left out:

notRestarted.mirror: A static pod: the kubelet brings back the same pod.
notRestarted.sextant: A node shell or debug copy of Sextant.
notRestarted.noController: No controller would create it again.
notRestarted.otherController: Restart does not work through its controller {{owner}}.
notRestarted.kind: Restart does not apply to it.

delete.ownedSingle: It has a controller that will likely create it again: deleting it replaces it rather than removes it. To remove it for good, delete or scale down the controller.
delete.owned_one: {{count}} of these objects has a controller (marked in the list) that will likely create it again: deleting it replaces it rather than removes it. To remove it for good, delete or scale down the controller.
delete.owned_other: {{count}} of these objects have a controller (marked in the list) that will likely create them again: deleting them replaces them rather than removes them. To remove them for good, delete or scale down their controllers.
delete.gitopsSingle: It is managed by Flux or Argo CD and may come back on the next sync.
delete.gitops_one: {{count}} of these objects is managed by Flux or Argo CD (marked in the list) and may come back on the next sync.
delete.gitops_other: {{count}} of these objects are managed by Flux or Argo CD (marked in the list) and may come back on the next sync.
delete.namespaces: Deleting a namespace deletes everything inside it: its workloads, Services, ConfigMaps, Secrets and PersistentVolumeClaims with their data.

syncedBy.argocd: may come back: Argo CD application {{name}}

delete.typeCount: To confirm, type the number of objects ({{number}}):

outcome.changed: Kept: {{name}} was replaced by another object of the same name since the list was shown.
